name: Splat Radius Adjustment Based on Normal Angle
definition: A method to adjust splat radii to prevent holes between splats when samples are elevated in the normal direction of the base plane, by scaling the radius based on the angle between the splat normal and the base plane normal.
summary: Splat Radius Adjustment Based on Normal Angle prevents visual holes in surface splatting by scaling splat radii according to the angle between the splat's normal and the base plane's normal.
